USA Today: Sabalenka d. Vondrousova injury walkover.
Brady retired after losing first set 6-1 (foot).
Kyrgios retired after sets 6-2 1-6; FAA awarded.
Mertens advanced by walkover vs Bouzkova; next-round presence confirms winner.
AP: de Minaur d. Blockx walkover.
Mannarino retired early in fifth; Federer 6-4 6-7(3) 3-6 6-2 0-0.
Williams retired at 3-3 (injury). Store status retired not walkover.
Dimitrov retired after three sets; Quinn 2-6 3-6 6-2.
Kokkinakis retired one game into third; Carreno 7-5 4-6.
Pliskova retired after three points (30-15 on Paolini serve).
Meligeni retired after three sets; Baez 6-7(7) 6-4 6-4.
Mertens d. Osorio 1-6 6-2 4-2 ret (Tennis Majors path).
